name: singlet_perturbation_guide_assignment
title: Assign perturbation guides to cells
description: Assigns each cell of a pooled CRISPR screen to the guide or guides it carries, from a raw cell-by-guide UMI count layer. Default method poisson_gauss (per-guide Poisson plus Gaussian mixture); threshold, max and ratio are fixed rules, gauss is a tied Gaussian mixture. Writes per-cell labels and status, a binary call matrix and per-guide count thresholds; needs a guide count layer, usually after feature-barcode counting and cell calling. Not for sample-hashtag demultiplexing, donor assignment or judging whether a guide reduced its target.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

guide_modality.description: Modality holding the guide count layer; receives the per-guide gdo/var fields.

layer.description: Layer of the guide modality with raw integer guide UMI counts; no normalisation is applied.

method.description: Assignment rule: threshold (count floor), max (top guide above floor), ratio (top-guide share), gauss (tied Gaussian mixture), poisson_gauss (Poisson plus Gaussian mixture).

batch_key.description: obs column of batch labels. When set, gauss and poisson_gauss are fitted separately per batch level; ignored by other methods.

calls.description: Options shaping the per-cell label, for all methods.

max_assignments_per_cell.description: Cells with more called guides than this are labelled multiple.

no_grna_assigned_key.description: Label for cells with no called guide; set to Negative to match pertpy threshold and max output.

multi_guide_separator.description: Separator joining the sorted guide names of multi-guide cells.

rules.description: Options of the count rules threshold, max and ratio.

assignment_threshold.description: Integer UMI floor, used by threshold and max. The default 5 is a tutorial value, not a published default.

min_guide_fraction.description: Share of the cell's guide UMIs the top guide must exceed, used by ratio only.

mixture.description: Options of the fitted mixtures gauss and poisson_gauss.

posterior_threshold.description: Signal posterior a count must exceed to be called; null uses 0.5.

n_iter.description: Optimiser steps, fixed number; null uses 250 for gauss and 500 for poisson_gauss.

learning_rate.description: Adam step size of the MAP fit.

n_init_seeds.description: Prior-based starts per guide for poisson_gauss; the start with the lowest initial objective is optimised. No effect on gauss.

min_nonzero_cells.description: Guides with fewer non-zero cells are not fitted, receive no calls and are reported.

min_max_count.description: Guides whose largest count is below this are not fitted, receive no calls and are reported.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for mixture starts; threshold, max and ratio are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, peak memory and device without fitting or writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing before anything is written.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/assigned_guide and gdo/var/threshold. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, n_cells, n_guides_input, n_guides_fitted, n_guides_skipped, n_guides_no_threshold, fraction_singlet, fraction_negative, fraction_multiple, fraction_unassigned, device_used, seed, batch_levels. Skipped guide names are kept in uns/guide_assignment_params. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, n_cells, n_guides, nnz.
